Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that Maya Bay on Ko Phi Phi Leh is in Phuket Province. In fact, Ko Phi Phi (including Ko Phi Phi Leh) belongs to Krabi Province. This geographic error could mislead the identification of the precise filming location within Thailand.
